items.source: Creates a version from a String that matches PATTERN; major, minor and revision numbers separated by dots with optional trailing characters.
items.translation: 根据与PATTERN匹配的字符串创建版本；由点分隔的主版本号、次版本号和修订号，并可选择带有尾部字符。

items.source: Creates a version from a String that matches PATTERN; major, minor and revision numbers separated by dots with optional trailing characters. A missing revision is treated as 0.
items.translation: 根据字符串创建与PATTERN匹配的版本；由点分隔的主版本号、次版本号和修订号，可选地带有尾部字符。缺失的修订号视为 0。

items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
items.translation: 指示某些其他对象是否“等于”当前对象。如果另一个对象属于同一类，且所有记录组件均相等，则这两个对象相等。本记录类中的所有组件均通过其对应包装类的compare方法进行比较。

items.source: A version defined by 3 parts: major minor and revision number.
items.translation: 由三个部分定义的版本：主版本号、次版本号和修订号。

items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one.
items.translation: 指示其他对象是否“等于”此对象。

items.translation: 返回此对象的哈希码值。

items.translation: 返回此记录类的字符串表示形式。

items.source: Returns a string representation of this record class. The representation contains the name of the class, followed by the name and value of each of the record components.
items.translation: 返回此记录类的字符串表示形式。该表示形式包含类名，随后是各记录组件的名称和值。

items.source: Returns a hash code value for this object. The value is derived from the hash code of each of the record components.
items.translation: 返回此对象的哈希码值。该值由每个记录组件的哈希码推导得出。
